page_title: EVE 2-2 LIV | Everton v Liverpool 12/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+14' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) receives a second yellow card and walks off the field of play!
90+13' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) is given a second yellow card for some unsportsmanlike conduct off the pitch.
90+12' Pointless reaction! Arne Slot (Liverpool) receives a red card for unsporting behaviour after the final whistle.
90+12' That's it for today, Michael Oliver has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+11' Michael Oliver sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
90+9' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Everton players aren’t happy.
90+8' 2 - 2 Goal! James Tarkowski (Everton) unleashes a first-time shot from inside the box and beats the goalkeeper into the top right corner. 2:2.
90+5' Jarrad Branthwaite (Everton) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
90+4' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
90+4' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Tim Iroegbunam (Everton) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well over the bar.
90+2' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The ball possession at the moment is 34:66. Total attempts – 8:6.
89' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.

88' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) releases a powerful first-time effort from the edge of the box which goes in the direction of the crossbar, but the keeper leaps like a salmon to deny him. Excellent goalkeeping!
88' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Luis Diaz leaves the pitch and Diogo Jota (Liverpool) comes on.
87' David Moyes has decided to make a change. Ashley Young (Everton) replaces James Garner.
86' That didn't go as planned! Beto (Everton) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the bottom left corner was too weak to get past Alisson, who easily kept it out.
85' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
81' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
80' The attendance for today's match is 39280.
77' A substitution has been made. Idrissa Gueye goes off and Tim Iroegbunam (Everton) comes on.
77' David Moyes prepares a substitution. Jesper Lindstrom is replaced by Carlos Alcaraz (Everton).
73' 1 - 2 Goal! Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) slots the ball into an unguarded net from close range after a shot rebounds off a defender. 1:2.
73' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) strikes the ball towards the right side of the goal despite being in a difficult position, but his shot is intercepted by one of the defenders.
72' A nice pass gives Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) the opportunity to shoot, but it's a weak shot and sails high over the bar.
71' The resulting free kick from Jack Harrison (Everton) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.
71' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Michael Oliver blows his whistle for a foul. Everton win a free kick.
69' Arne Slot has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) replacing Cody Gakpo.
69' It will be a substitution. Konstantinos Tsimikas (Liverpool) is ready to enter the pitch as Andrew Robertson walks off.
68' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Jarrad Branthwaite (Everton) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
67' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Everton will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
67' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton).
63' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) sees a yellow card from Michael Oliver after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
62' Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the referee wasn't in the best position. Let's see what he decides.
61' Arne Slot has decided to substitute Conor Bradley and he is replaced by Curtis Jones (Liverpool).
61' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Ryan Gravenberch walks off the pitch to be replaced by Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool).
59' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) is adjudged offside.
55' Jack Harrison (Everton) unleashes a shot, but it's well wide of the right-hand post.
54' A lofted cross finds an unmarked Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton), who leaps high and powers a header at goal. However, his header goes miles past the right post. Poor effort.
52' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
49' James Garner (Everton) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
48' Beto (Everton) is penalised for a foul. Michael Oliver had a clear view and blows his whistle.
46' Jack Harrison (Everton) goes on a mazy run and tries his luck with a mid-range strike, but one of the defending players steps in and makes a block.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+6' The first half of today's match has just finished.

45+5' Jordan Pickford makes a brilliant save! Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) easily weaves through the defence and fires the ball from mid-range. His effort goes towards the bottom left corner but is saved by the keeper!
45+3' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
45+2' Conor Bradley (Liverpool) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Michael Oliver had an easy-decision to make.
45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
43' Beto (Everton) latches on to a cross but heads the ball miles wide of the right post. Such a bad header.
42' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) commits a foul and Michael Oliver immediately signals a free kick.
42' The ball is cleared after Beto (Everton) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
38' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
38' A beautiful low pass from the side is received by Luis Diaz (Liverpool), who was waiting for his chance. However, the defence is alert and spanks the ball away. Liverpool get a corner.
37' Idrissa Gueye (Everton) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
37' Jack Harrison (Everton) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
35' Jesper Lindstrom (Everton) attempts to discuss the decision with Michael Oliver, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.
35' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle.
32' Liverpool control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
27' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) sees a yellow! His tackle wasn't that harsh, but he probably talked himself into Michael Oliver's book.
27' Jesper Lindstrom (Everton) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
26' Referee Michael Oliver sees the trip by Conor Bradley (Liverpool) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Everton have been awarded a free kick.
25' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jack Harrison (Everton) comes onto the pitch so that Iliman Ndiaye can be given a rest.
24' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) looks like he won’t be able to continue.
21' Looks like Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
19' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.

16' 1 - 1 Goal! Mohamed Salah clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool), who jumps highest and steers a bullet header from the centre of the box into the left side of the goal. Jordan Pickford had no chance of stopping that. 1:1.
15' Free kick. Liverpool will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
11' 1 - 0 Goal! Jarrad Branthwaite plays a short, square pass into the path of Beto (Everton), who bends a shot straight into the bottom right corner to make it 1:0. Fabulous goal!
10' A mid-range free kick is awarded to Everton out wide and from this angle a cross into the box is likely.
9' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Liverpool.
5' Beto (Everton) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
5' The resulting corner from James Garner (Everton) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
4' Jesper Lindstrom (Everton) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball goes out of play. Everton are awarded a corner kick.
2' Flag up against Luis Diaz (Liverpool). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Everton will have the kick-off.
Michael Oliver will officiate today.
